response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming (only brief C/C++ exposure at National Instruments ~6 months) and shows no evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership at the depth required. His career is heavily weighted toward web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, Ember, DLang) rather than C++-based large-scale infrastructure or cloud compute platforms.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and teaching (workshops, talks, Staff/Senior titles)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, architecture, open-source platform ownership)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments) vs. required 8 years
No demonstrated experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed systems at scale, or hardware/storage architecture
Career trajectory is product/full-stack focused rather than infrastructure/platform engineering leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/distributed infrastructure experience
Strong leadership and mentoring track record
